Maya: Quick preflight — I want a final check on the latency-vs-cost chart variants before we lock slides for the launch post. Thoughts?
Sam: Can we show both tail-latency and avg? Tail tells enterprise story.
Elaine: Agree, tail + 95th percentile. Also need a tiny caption about batch+cache assumptions.
Jon: +1. Also call out model variants: small | quantized | large. Want markers on points.
Maya: Exact wording: "Redwood: 3x lower per-token cost at comparable latency" — is that defensible?
Sam: Need backup numbers. From last bench run: small=0.7ms/token @ $0.0007, quant=1.1ms/token @ $0.0004, large=3.5ms/token @ $0.0018
bench-bot: Bench run 2026-02-14 14:12 UTC — artifacts: /bench/artifacts/20260214-run42
Elaine: Can we get a clean CSV for charting? Something like:
```
variant,avg_ms,95th_ms,cost_per_1k
small,0.7,2.1,0.7
quantized,1.1,3.0,0.4
large,3.5,9.2,1.8
```
Jon: For the launch post we should show two charts: 1) latency vs cost scatter, 2) token-cost waterfall for a 100-token prompt. 
Maya: For messaging, prefer claim -> how we measure -> link to methodology. Short caption under chart: "Measured on real inference workload with prefix caching enabled." 
Sam: CTA routing: inbound form should ask if they care more about latency or unit-cost. Route "latency" to enterprise SDRs, "cost" to PLG growth. 
Elaine: Webinar idea: demo sample app, then deep-dive into batching/cache knobs. 20 min demo + 25 min Q&A.
Maya: Sounds good. @Sam can you make the CSV and drop chart PNGs by EOD? I'll draft hero lines.
Sam: On it. Dropping assets by 5pm PT. 
Maya: Thanks all :rocket:
